text_block_list.text: While heading to the trainer's office...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: The rain... It's not raining, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Whether by shoe divination or flower 
petals, they both said "Definite rain 
today"...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
To think that a divine oracle's 
fortune-telling would be wrong... This 
must surely be an omen of misfortune!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! I bet a huge line of sumo wrestlers 
will block the crosswalk so I can't cross, 
or a sudden gust of wind will blow my 
offering right into the pond, waaah!

I desperately managed to calm her down 
afterward, but the whole commotion ended 
up putting her in poor shape...
